findings.title: Prototype hygiene (donor font names + A10 checker fails)
findings.detail: A1 CSS still names donor/vendor fonts (Cascadia Code, Segoe UI). Reports may cite sources; UI text/CSS must stay clean.
findings.owner: A1 (neutral font stack) + A0 (adjudicate system fonts)
findings.resolution_partial: Donor NAMES fully removed (Rebased/JetBrains/Obsidian/IntelliJ = 0): A11 H-brand PASS and A10 P1 PASS.
